description: Give BB Notion's page colours and type in light and dark, then pick Default, Serif or Mono for messages. Menus, dialogs, switches and your own bubble follow those shapes; markdown in the thread uses Notion's inline code, quotes, headings and tables. Hover cards close when the pointer leaves, and a click pins them. A notice on the prompt box appears when a provider window is exhausted and can retry at reset. No account; licensed Notion fonts are named first, then system fallbacks.
